bodyReview.heading: Account for delivery and absorption
bodyReview.before: Food requirements, bariatric or major gastrointestinal surgery, feeding tubes, dysphagia, vomiting, malabsorption, and dosage-form manipulation can change exposure or feasibility. Select a product and route with evidence for the patient's anatomy and administration pathway.
bodyReview.after: Check whether the patient can swallow and retain the prescribed oral dose, then verify the exact product and administration pathway. For rivaroxaban tablets delivered through an NG or gastric feeding tube, keep delivery within the stomach and immediately follow a crushed 15 or 20 mg dose with enteral feeding. Dabigatran capsules must remain intact; do not open them to prepare a feeding-tube dose. Vomiting or an unsuitable gastrointestinal route can make oral delivery impractical. Reassess the product and route rather than assuming that crushing a dosage form will provide reliable treatment.
